leads.name: Weiße Villa Platane, Schanzelgasse 33
leads.location_hint: register_id 18, object_id 4, ND992, Schanzelgasse 33, Geidorf, 47.078757,15.460335. Girth 4.90m measured 2015 per Wikipedia's 'Liste der Naturdenkmäler in Graz'.
leads.why_not_shipped: Owner recorded as oeffentlich (public) in the Stadt Graz register, but the address is the former Villa Kleinoscheg (1853), now a renovated apartment building known as the 'Weiße Villa' sitting in its own park on a rise. Could not confirm this pass whether the surrounding grounds are genuinely open to the public or now effectively private residential grounds despite the public ownership flag. A large, well-documented tree with a real girth measurement, worth a proper access check before shipping.

leads.name: Eggenberger Allee 90 cluster (Schlosspark Eggenberg) - remaining 8 of 10
leads.species: Platane (Platanus x acerifolia) x5 (ND 977-981), Weymouthskiefer (Pinus strobus) x3 (ND 982-984)
leads.location_hint: City register NUMMER 2-9 (excl. 11), all at Eggenberger Allee 90, Algersdorf, within about 60m of each other around 47.0748,15.3910 to 47.0729,15.3915. Matches Wikipedia ND 977-985 (excl. 986).
leads.why_not_shipped: Verification pass 2026-08-17 shipped the two genuinely individual, documented specimens from this cluster as grz_009 (Weymouth pine ND986/register NUMMER 11, measured 3.70m girth) and grz_010 (Blutbuche ND1506). These remaining 5 planes and 3 pines share the same address, protection date (11.07.1979) and no individuating measurement or record in any source checked; as a group they read as an avenue/grove planting rather than separate collectible points, per the hard rule that an avenue is blocked while a single named tree is not. Not re-researched deeper this pass (time cutoff); a future pass could still check each individually against a fresh source (e.g. a dated Commons photo or a distinctive girth) before shipping any as its own entry, but absent that they stay here as a group rather than as ten redundant near-duplicate pages of one planting.

leads.name: Elisabethstraße 48 Plane
leads.location_hint: register_id 27, object_id 69, ND1000, Elisabethstraße 48, St. Leonhard, 47.075646,15.454619, protected 11.07.1979.
leads.why_not_shipped: Not reached this pass (time cutoff at 8 verified trees). 1.33km from centre, inside the same walkable radius as the shipped cluster. Register + Wikipedia already cross-match within 4m; just needs an access/context check (street tree vs. building forecourt) before writing.

leads.name: Hilmteichstraße 104 pair (Hemlocktanne + Blutbuche)
leads.location_hint: register_ids 80/91 and 78/124, ND1131 and ND1129, both Hilmteichstraße 104, Wenisbuch, ~47.083,15.463, about 2.3km from centre.
leads.why_not_shipped: Not reached this pass. Owner recorded oeffentlich in the register but the specific site at this address was not identified (could be a school, institution or park; Hilmteich itself, the well-known lake park, is nearby but this address was not confirmed to be inside it). Needs an access check.

leads.name: Annaplatz 2 Oak
leads.species: Eiche (oak, species unspecified beyond genus in the register)
leads.location_hint: register_id 87, object_id 93, ND1136, Annaplatz 2, Algersdorf, 47.079944,15.395974, protected 12.09.1990.
leads.why_not_shipped: Not reached this pass; 3.38km from centre, outside the tight cluster chosen this time. Register species field only says 'Eiche' without a Latin binomial, so species would need pinning down to genus/species level before writing.

blocked.name: Rosenberggürtel 12 Paulownia
blocked.reason: Address is a kindergarten (Heilpädagogischer Kindergarten für Hör- und Sprachbildung / KIGA Rosenberg), confirmed by search. No evidence found that the grounds are open to the public; per hard rule 10's schools test, absent real evidence of open access a school site stays blocked rather than shipped.

blocked.name: Körblergasse 106 Mammutbaum and Eibe
blocked.location_hint: register_ids 99/46 and 98/45, ND1148 and ND1147, both Körblergasse 106, Geidorf, ~47.089,15.4415. Both carry real 2015 girth measurements from Wikipedia (Mammutbaum 5.50m, Eibe 2.70m) which is a shame to leave on the table.
blocked.reason: Address is the Landesjugendheim Rosenhof, a state-run children's and youth care home with attached academies (midwifery, social work, chemistry). Not open to the public; sending strangers onto the grounds of a youth care institution is exactly the harm hard rule 10 exists to prevent. Blocked outright, not just parked as a lead.
